You analyse robot practice logs for a programmer. Be concrete and brief.
You never write code. You point at line numbers and robot calls.

Task: Push the orange puck so that its centre ends up inside the green circle. The puck is too wide to grasp.

Skill code (numbered):
  1| import math
  2| import numpy as np
  3| 
  4| def run(robot):
  5|     # Workspace bounds (safety layer)
  6|     X_MIN, X_MAX = 0.04, 0.32
  7|     Y_MIN, Y_MAX = -0.26, 0.26
  8|     
  9|     def clamp_xy(x, y):
 10|         return (max(X_MIN, min(X_MAX, x)), max(Y_MIN, min(Y_MAX, y)))
 11|     
 12|     def rotate_vec(v, angle):
 13|         ca, sa = math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle)
 14|         return np.array([ca * v[0] - sa * v[1], sa * v[0] + ca * v[1]])
 15|     
 16|     def ensure_clearance(xy, margin=0.05):
 17|         """Shift xy away from walls if closer than margin."""
 18|         x, y = xy
 19|         shifted = False
 20|         if x - X_MIN < margin:
 21|             x = X_MIN + margin
 22|             shifted = True
 23|         if X_MAX - x < margin:
 24|             x = X_MAX - margin
 25|             shifted = True
 26|         if y - Y_MIN < margin:
 27|             y = Y_MIN + margin
 28|             shifted = True
 29|         if Y_MAX - y < margin:
 30|             y = Y_MAX - margin
 31|             shifted = True
 32|         return (x, y) if shifted else xy
 33|     
 34|     max_attempts = 4
 35|     push_z = 0.02          # tool-point height: finger pads ~0.0075, puck centre ~0.01
 36|     approach_dist = 0.05   # 2 cm behind puck edge (radius 0.03 + 0.02)
 37|     
 38|     for attempt in range(max_attempts):
 39|         obs = robot.observe()
 40|         puck = obs["objects"]["puck"]
 41|         target = obs["fixtures"]["target"]
 42|         
 43|         puck_pos = np.array(puck["pos"])
 44|         target_pos = np.array(target["pos"])
 45|         target_radius = target["radius"]
 46|         
 47|         # Robust radius extraction: size may be dict or list; default to 0.03 m
 48|         puck_size = puck.get("size", {})
 49|         if isinstance(puck_size, dict):
 50|             puck_radius = puck_size.get("radius", 0.03)
 51|         elif isinstance(puck_size, (list, tuple)) and len(puck_size) > 0:
 52|             puck_radius = puck_size[0]
 53|         else:
 54|             puck_radius = 0.03
 55|         puck_yaw = puck.get("yaw", 0.0)
 56|         
 57|         # Vector from puck to target (XY only)
 58|         to_target = target_pos[:2] - puck_pos[:2]
 59|         dist_to_target = np.linalg.norm(to_target)
 60|         
 61|         if dist_to_target <= target_radius + 1e-3:
 62|             robot.log(f"Success: puck in target, dist={dist_to_target:.4f}")
 63|             return True
 64|         
 65|         # Base push direction
 66|         push_dir = to_target / dist_to_target
 67|         
 68|         # Lead angle to counteract sideways slide of upright puck
 69|         lead_angle = 0.8 * puck_radius / max(dist_to_target, 0.01)
 70|         push_dir = rotate_vec(push_dir, lead_angle)
 71|         
 72|         # Check puck orientation: yaw in [-pi/4, pi/4), 0 = faces aligned with world axes
 73|         # Edge-on when |yaw| ~ pi/4. Dot product with push_dir indicates face-on vs edge-on.
 74|         puck_forward = np.array([math.cos(puck_yaw), math.sin(puck_yaw)])
 75|         face_on = abs(np.dot(puck_forward, push_dir))
 76|         
 77|         # If edge-on (face_on < 0.5), increase approach distance and raise push_z slightly
 78|         local_approach_dist = approach_dist
 79|         local_push_z = push_z
 80|         if face_on < 0.5:
 81|             local_approach_dist += 0.02
 82|             local_push_z += 0.01
 83|         
 84|         # If puck already close to target, start farther back to reduce impact
 85|         if dist_to_target < 0.1:
 86|             local_approach_dist = max(local_approach_dist, 0.08)
 87|         
 88|         # Start position behind puck
 89|         start_xy = puck_pos[:2] - push_dir * local_approach_dist
 90|         start_xy = ensure_clearance(start_xy, margin=0.05)
 91|         start_xy = clamp_xy(start_xy[0], start_xy[1])
 92|         
 93|         # End position: push past target by puck_radius + margin
 94|         push_distance = dist_to_target + puck_radius + 0.04
 95|         end_xy = puck_pos[:2] + push_dir * push_distance
 96|         end_xy = clamp_xy(end_xy[0], end_xy[1])
 97|         
 98|         # Move to start: above first, then down
 99|         try:
100|             robot.move_to(start_xy[0], start_xy[1], 0.10, speed=0.15)
101|             robot.move_to(start_xy[0], start_xy[1], local_push_z, speed=0.05)
102|         except Exception as e:
103|             robot.log(f"Move to start failed: {e}")
104|             continue
105|         
106|         # Push forward with yaw aligned to push direction, slow speed to avoid jamming
107|         push_yaw = math.atan2(push_dir[1], push_dir[0])
108|         try:
109|             robot.move_to(end_xy[0], end_xy[1], local_push_z, yaw=push_yaw, speed=0.02)
110|         except Exception as e:
111|             robot.log(f"Push move failed: {e}")
112|             continue
113|         
114|         robot.wait(0.2)  # let physics settle
115|         
116|         # Re-observe and check success
117|         obs = robot.observe()
118|         puck = obs["objects"]["puck"]
119|         puck_pos = np.array(puck["pos"])
120|         to_target = target_pos[:2] - puck_pos[:2]
121|         dist_to_target = np.linalg.norm(to_target)
122|         if dist_to_target <= target_radius + 1e-3:
123|             robot.log(f"Success: puck in target, dist={dist_to_target:.4f}")
124|             return True
125|         else:
126|             robot.log(f"Attempt {attempt+1}: puck dist to target = {dist_to_target:.4f}")
127|     
128|     # Final check after attempts
129|     obs = robot.observe()
130|     puck = obs["objects"]["puck"]
131|     target = obs["fixtures"]["target"]
132|     puck_pos = np.array(puck["pos"])
133|     target_pos = np.array(target["pos"])
134|     target_radius = target["radius"]
135|     dist = np.linalg.norm(target_pos[:2] - puck_pos[:2])
136|     robot.log(f"Final dist to target: {dist:.4f}, target radius: {target_radius:.4f}")
137|     return dist <= target_radius + 1e-3
